title: kate-ui: open the quick open and command palettes
summary: cmd-p opens quick open over the project files, or over the open document paths when no project is loaded. cmd-shift-p opens the command palette. Typing filters the rows, up and down move the selection, enter opens the file or runs the command, and escape closes.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

definitions.definition:
/// Paths quick open searches: the project files when a project is loaded, else the open document paths.
fn quick_open_paths(project: Option<&[std::path::PathBuf]>, open: &[std::path::PathBuf]) -> Vec<String>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Store a palette state on WindowRoot: kind (QuickOpen or Commands), query, selected. Render it as an overlay at the top center with the query field and up to 12 rows; matched positions in a row paint bold. Enter in QuickOpen sends FileRequest::OpenPath for base_dir joined with the row detail; in Commands it runs the entry command through run_command. Up and down call palette::step_selection. Escape closes. Bind cmd-p and cmd-shift-p and add both to a Go menu. quick_open_paths returns the project list as strings when Some, else the open paths. The test quick_open_paths_prefers_the_project asserts Some([a.rs]) with open [b.rs] gives [a.rs] and None gives [b.rs]. The owner opens a file by name and runs Undo from the palette. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::quick_open_paths_prefers_the_project
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because quick_open_paths does not exist. After the change the project list wins and the open paths are the fallback.
